subject: Upgrade onramp & QBR scheduling
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Luis Ortega <luis.ortega@heliolabs.com>, Bethany Lowe <bethany.lowe@heliolabs.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 23 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Upgrade onramp & QBR scheduling

Hi Luis / Bethany —

Thanks for confirming interest in the capacity uplift. I wanted to kick off the onramp and propose a short timeline so we can lock in the resources and schedule the QBR that will finalize the term changes. High-level proposal: 

- Week 0 (this week): mutual action plan sign-off + initial PO/terms ack
- Week 1: capacity provisioning and SRE onboarding (staging run)
- Week 2: load validation + performance baseline
- Week 3: production cutover + QBR readout

Proposed QBR windows (all PDT):
- Thu 9/2, 10:00–11:00 or 16:00–17:00
- Mon 9/6, 11:00–12:00 (preferred by our execs)

Please confirm: (1) the appropriate procurement/legal contact for PO/terms, (2) the technical SRE lead we should loop in for provisioning, and (3) if either QBR window works. I attached a short Mutual_Action_Plan_HelioLabs_v1.pdf with owners/SLAs and a link to the HubSpot deal for visibility.

Next steps on our side if you confirm the above: we’ll provision a dedicated pool, assign an internal SRE, and send a short runbook for the Week 2 validation.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: Mutual_Action_Plan_HelioLabs_v1.pdf
From: Luis Ortega <luis.ortega@heliolabs.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Bethany Lowe <bethany.lowe@heliolabs.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 23 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Upgrade onramp & QBR scheduling

Jordan —

Appreciate the clear plan. We’re aligned on moving forward with the uplift. A few quick items from procurement/legal: 

- PO will be issued once we confirm final commitment numbers (please mark expected monthly token/embedding volumes).
- Legal will need a short review (we can turn around in ~3 business days once we have the updated term sheet).

QBR windows: 9/2 at 16:00–17:00 works best for our leadership. 9/6 conflicts with an internal all-hands.

SRE lead: Bethany Lowe (bethany.lowe@heliolabs.com) will be our technical partner — I’ve cc’d her. She’ll validate the runbook and coordinate on provisioning.

One ask from finance: can Redwood provide a short pricing summary for the uplift path (delta vs current commit) and any prorated billing for the partial-month change? If you can include that in the Mutual Action Plan or as a one-pager, that would speed PO approval.

Thanks —
Luis Ortega
Head of Procurement | HelioLabs
luis.ortega@heliolabs.com
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Sun, 23 Aug 2026 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Upgrade onramp & QBR scheduling

Thanks Jordan / Luis —

Quick operational notes from CS/SRE side: 

- We’ll attach an MVP_capacity_plan.xlsx with the initial GPU/throughput targets for staging and production; this will help finance estimate the delta.
- Requesting that Bethany confirm the list of test accounts and a small sample dataset for Week 2 validation (need roughly 50–100 representative requests to validate latency & throughput).
- Rishi, can you provide a short pricing delta one-pager for Luis (prorated billing options + seat vs token comparison)? I’ve added that to the action list below.

Action items / owners: 
- Jordan: finalize Mutual Action Plan and update with expected volumes (ASAP)
- Rishi: pricing delta one-pager for finance (by Tue EOD)
- Bethany: test account list + preferred validation window (by Mon)
- Monica: schedule the QBR for 9/2 16:00 PDT if confirmation received

I’ll also share a lightweight runbook link in the Drive folder so Bethany can review.

Best,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com

Attachments referenced: MVP_capacity_plan.xlsx (see Drive folder)

Perfect — thanks everyone for the quick responses. Recap and next steps (locking in):

- QBR: scheduled for Thu 2026-09-02 16:00–17:00 PDT (calendar invite to follow from Monica).
- Jordan: I’ll update the Mutual_Action_Plan_HelioLabs_v1.pdf with expected monthly token volumes and attach a pricing delta one-pager (Rishi will provide numbers).
- Rishi: please share prorated billing and delta summary by Tue 8/25 EOD.
- Bethany: please drop the test account list and preferred validation slot in the Drive folder by Mon 8/24 so we can provision staging.
- Monica: will create the calendar event and include the remote runbook link.
